## Description

Use English with a clear and concise description of the bug. If the same problem happens on NSH's own backends (iOS, Android, desktop), please report it to [longbridge/nsh](https://github.com/longbridge/nsh/issues) instead.

## Environment

- NSH: [e.g., `nsh --version`, or the commit]
- nsh-platform-harmonyos: [the commit]
- Device: [e.g., OpenHarmony 7.0 (API 26) emulator, HarmonyOS NEXT on Mate 70]
- How it runs: [e.g., `nsh run --target harmonyos`, `nsh package`, DevEco Studio, embedded in an app]

## Steps to Reproduce

The smallest `App.tsx` that shows the problem, then:

1. Tap '...'
2. Scroll to '....'
3. See error

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots or recordings to help explain your problem.

## Expected

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

## Actual

A clear and concise description of what actually happened, with the logs (`hdc hilog`) if any.
